items.message: Terafab Deep Dive: the 9 card-news images in all four languages are redesigned on one ink background, with color carried by the labels, bars, blocks and numbers. Content and figures unchanged; the cover line now reads "70% of 1 million in total"

New research: Terafab Deep Dive. The 700K-memory-wafer target, EUV and capital math, the missing DRAM technology source, a disruption-theory verdict, base rates, scenarios, a value-chain map and a 24-month checklist, with 33 earlier claims rechecked against their sources (Hanmi Semiconductor order now marked as conflicting reports). Full report and 9 card-news images in all four languages

Railroad vs. chips report: added the original 19th-century railroad chart (Cowles-Shiller monthly, 1871~1903, same format as the SOX chart) to section 1, and rebuilt card 2 as that chart with BofA and Cowles figures side by side, so it reads next to the SOX card
Berkshire page headline simplified to "Tracking Berkshire Hathaway." (the "like SpaceX" comparison is gone from the page and its hub card)
The SpaceX–Anthropic 90-day-clause report's 15 card-news images now use the hub's dark navy look like every other report (all four languages); the orange highlights, bars and numbers are unchanged
Research menu: tapping Research now opens All research (the full library) first; below it, the SpaceX pages sit under SpaceX analysis and Berkshire under its own heading

Every research report now reads in full in English, Spanish and Japanese: all 17 reports, including their charts and card news (redrawn in each language) and the three interactive reports. English readers land on the English version automatically, the library links to your language, and the Korean original stays one tap away

Research menu tidied: the SpaceX pages (SpaceX, Mix, Score, Overnight agent, Lock-up) now sit together under a SpaceX analysis heading, and Berkshire moves under More research next to the research library, in the menu and in page order

New research: 130 Years Apart, Same Rhythm. BofA's three late-1800s railroad drawdowns cross-checked with Cowles-Shiller data and replayed on actual chip-index (SOX) closes, a three-layer view of who fell hardest, what happened to railroads after 1903, 4 charts and 9 cards

New BERKSHIRE page under Research, next to SpaceX: a Claude probe tracks Berkshire Hathaway like SpaceX, with 14 milestones on 5 axes, scenarios and a value band, a disruption watch for each moat, every SEC filing graded, and the latest report. Synced from univertrix every 3 hours in 4 languages; also at /data/berkshire.json

New research: The 90-Day Clause and Chamath's Math. A fact-check of 20 claims about the SpaceX–Anthropic compute deal against SEC filings, with unit economics, a disruptive-innovation reading of Chamath's logic, scenario odds and 15 cards

Fortune Danji grows to five live tools plus Madang: 2027 My Year (your twelve months of 2027), Chaltteok (name game and a saju match two people open together) and Ireum Seodang (name reports and exhaustive naming) are now live, and Madang, a 3D yard where you walk between the jars, gets its own spot

Buffett Index and VIX charts open big: tap either chart on the radar's Buffett × VIX tab for a full-size window with a crosshair that shows the date, the value, its zone and (for VIX) the VIX ÷ VIX3M ratio that day

Links land where they point: tapping a TODAY card, a hub card or a menu item now jumps straight to that page and holds it in place while the pages above finish loading, so you no longer see another page first or need to tap twice (this mattered most on iPhone)

New research: Was AI an illusion? A fact-check of the Nov 5 AI shock. Money and permits broke, not demand: GPU rents +79% while CoreWeave CDS hit 1,038bp. Three-layer verdict, 1/3/5/10-year odds, every correction from two fact-check rounds, and 12 card-news images in Korean and English

Smoother hub and readable K-leverage charts: pages no longer snap to the next screen while you scroll (the top menu takes you anywhere); click any K-leverage chart for a large window with a crosshair that shows the date and values; the regime map's y-axis label is no longer cut off; the breakdown of the two scores is open by default

K-leverage made plain: “fuel” and “fire” are now “debt load” and “forced selling”, a RIGHT NOW sentence explains today’s reading in one breath, a how-to-read card shows what each of the four zones means, every input says what it measures, the late 07:50 report shows as late instead of skipping to Monday, and a weekday 19:40 hub-only refresh brings the day-fresher KOFIA date
AI Deleveraging Check: the liquidation-tracker card now shows the date of each report (Korean and English)

Data truth on TODAY: every number shows its as-of date (US close, report day, daily estimate), LIVE turns into DELAYED when newer market data exists, and VIX now comes from the fresher of the two bot runs instead of the older crisis report; the Buffett x VIX check now refreshes after every US close

Faster first screen: the last live data you saw shows instantly on your next visit while fresh data loads behind it, TODAY shows loading shimmers instead of sample numbers, the hidden developer view no longer rebuilds on every update, page sizing reads all pages in one pass, deep-page feeds load when the browser is idle, and fonts stop blocking the first paint

New research: AI Deleveraging Check (chips -12.25% on Nov 5) with a liquidation tracker, leveraged-ETF mechanics, Anthropic S-1 breakdown and 10 cards in Korean and English; every credit across the site is now just stayhungryasi.com
Every page footer now has one-tap channel icons: YouTube, Instagram, X, Threads, TikTok and Telegram; the credit line points to stayhungryasi.com
The US midterms report now shows the 9 summary cards in English for English readers (election-night times in ET), with full-size JPGs and 9:16 versions alongside

The US midterms report now opens with a 9-card summary (odds, Senate battlegrounds, AI financing, oil and the Fed, red-team corrections, sectors, the Korea-time election-night checklist and the post-vote calendar)

Mobile quick menu: a thumb-reach dock at the bottom (previous · menu · next · top) shows where you are, and the menu opens a sheet with every page grouped like the top menu, a live number on each tile and instant search in 4 languages; swipe down or Esc to close

New research: the 2026 US midterms through a disruptive-innovation lens, red-team edition. Markets vs models, a scenario tree, a sector heat map, the election-night checklist in Korea time and the post-vote calendar, with 8 charts; checked twice by independent red teams (Oct 29 and Nov 2, election eve); in 4 languages

New research: Anthropic's S-1 through a disruptive-innovation lens. S-curve, compute efficiency, the 2027 commitment wall, a probability-weighted value range and the price-performance gap, with 5 new charts, after four rounds of independent checks against the filing; in 4 languages

Market-cap rank and earnings go live from univertrix.com: RANK shows the global Top 20 every day with a Top 5/10/20 switch, month-end rank chart, who entered and who left, and the research question of whether the month-end Top N works as a universe; EARNINGS now covers every Top 20 report date in your time zone, reported ones with the market-cap move around the report; hub cards 11 and 12 go live; in 4 languages

SpaceX overnight research agent goes live: the same cockpit univertrix.com shows, synced every 3 hours from universe-dominator's agent: what changed this run, share price vs the assumed value band, scenarios and probability by run, every milestone by axis with progress and detail, triggers with last forecast vs what happened, probability rules, latest quarter and the latest report; untranslated lines marked KO; under Research, in 4 languages
YouTube link fixed: the channel row and the channel card now open Future Field Trip (youtube.com/@futurefieldtrip)

Institutional 5% filing radar goes live: large-holding reports from global managers, pensions, sovereign funds, IBs and activists, sorted into control / real buying / watch / mechanical by splitting each filing's change table (on-market buys vs lending, swaps, existing holdings), with 40 days of history, filters, most active filers and the watchlist; under Markets, in 4 languages

Fortune Danji on the hub: the free, ad-free saju tools jar with Yeouido Jeomjip (a daily money-luck report written like a sell-side note) and Anchak (when a hard stretch ends), plus spots for the 2027 New Year fortune and the naming service on the way; under Built, hub card 9, in 4 languages

Easier top menu: 20 tabs folded into 6 groups (Today, Research, Markets, UNIVERTRIX, Built, Hub) that open a list of their pages; text 11.5px → 15px and brighter, the current group underlined, and the text-size button now scales the menu too

New SOFTWARE page: the tools I build with Claude, starting with No. 01 MoCapture, a Windows capture tool with no ads, no alerts and no network (instant editor, automatic masking of private numbers, window and scroll capture, offline text copy), with screens, numbers, releases and install-safety facts; on the hub as card 8, in 4 languages

New research: Claude and GPT Models × Effort Matrix. Thirteen Claude models and the GPT-6 family across five effort levels, mapped to five work tasks with Artificial Analysis per-effort measurements (rechecked Oct 24, adds Haiku 5.5); Opus 5.5 at high costs 30% of Fable 5.1 at extra high

K-leverage monitor on the hub: Korea's margin loans, forced selling, unsettled margin and deposits from the debt bot, read as fuel × fire with a 60-day regime map, 1-year margin loans vs KOSPI, 60-day forced selling and 10-year margin loans / market cap; updated after every Mon/Wed/Fri report, in 4 languages

STAY HUNGRY morning card on the hub: the quote bot's daily card (checked quote, the story behind it, today's order) on a new QUOTE page and on TODAY, with this week's seven themes; a new card opens at 08:00 KST like the Telegram channel, in 4 languages

New research: The Superintelligence Bet, Rechecked. Six weeks after ARK swapped GOOGL for META, META leads by 1.5 points; on forward earnings Meta (19.5x) is now cheaper than Alphabet (23.9x), the market reads AI capex as borrowing, and the author's top five becomes Nvidia, SK hynix, Amazon, Alphabet, TSMC

Daily brief: every morning Claude picks the three things that matter most across the whole hub (lock-ups, key dates, crisis and valuation, research) for TODAY and BRIEF, in 4 languages with the reason; without a pick the page chooses from live data itself

New research: Terafab Equipment Map. How much chip equipment Musk's fab will really buy (phase 1 ≈ 3–4% of global WFE, author's estimate), who is confirmed vs only in talks, hidden winners from the in-house mask shop, and the risks
Easier to read: pages no longer shrink below 92% (taller pages scroll instead), small text is 1–2px larger, gray text is brighter, and a new text-size button (Aa) offers 100 / 112 / 125%

SpaceX lock-up radar goes live: next unlock with countdown to the US open, the full unlock ladder, tradable vs locked share gauge, cumulative unlock curve, SPCX price with unlock days and the Telegram cards, updated every morning by the bot
YouTube channel linked: the HUB channel row and the ShaferwineX card now open youtube.com/@ShaferwineX

Key dates go live: the schedule bot's Telegram list becomes an AGENDA page with a 7-day board, next big date countdown, KST or your own time, category filters, recent changes, 75-day outlook, a source link on every date and calendar feeds (.ics) in 4 languages
TODAY cards now open the right radar tab: Crisis proximity → crisis early warning, VIX and Buffett Index → Buffett Index × VIX

UNIVERTRIX menu page: all 8 rooms of univertrix.com (Universe rulers, Next rulers, Megatrends, Data observatory, Pioneers, Shoulders of giants, Signal observatory, Must-read dissection) with a one-line explainer, live numbers from univertrix.com and a direct link each
BRAINS gets a third engine: the Musk engine (first principles, the five-step algorithm, the idiot index, honest timeline checks), a three-way brain duel and a full report at /p/musk-brain/

Research library goes live: 8 reports in full (USD/KRW, 20 years of rates vs stocks, Ethereum, cybersecurity, AI-uncorrelated growth, AI Capital Flow Map, Damodaran fact check, Ken Griffin), each with a brief in 4 languages, a key number, checkpoints, RSS and JSON
The TODAY valuation card is now named Buffett Index
Fact-check fixes: credit layer colour matches the bot, VIX shown to 2 decimals, Buffett history dated at quarter end, footers say exactly which report each number comes from
Fact check: every crisis and Buffett × VIX number re-verified against FRED, Cboe, Yahoo, ECOS and Fed Z.1; stale sample text removed from BRIEF, TODAY and the dev view
Buffett Index × VIX goes live: a second radar tab with the bot’s numbers, history charts since 1947, the valuation × fear matrix and the Telegram cards
Crisis radar goes live: the early-warning bot now publishes every Telegram report here (score, 5 layers, 21 indicators, charts)
Cleaner footers: the email address now appears only on the News page, next to the contact cards
News page: a Show all button opens every update in place, plus a link to all commits on GitHub
BRAINS: ask the Buffett·Munger and Jensen thinking engines, or make them duel (live AI with prepared answers as backup)
UNIVERTRIX dev log: five months and 862 commits on one page, plus /data/univertrix.json
Say hi: foolish@, commit@ and grateful@stayhungryasi.com, plus a thank-you address in every language
New home: stayhungryasi.com (HTTPS, old links redirect)
Open data API, quick open (Ctrl+P), vim keys, this changelog and a few easter eggs
Developer view comes alive: live typing, tests in watch mode, streaming chat
Editor polish: native font, minimap, terminal toolbar
Esc opens a code editor with an AI pair chat
Snap deck: one screen per page
Card-news design system
Launch in English, Korean, Spanish and Japanese
